name: Crucible of the Spirit Dragon
description: The ruins where the rebellion leaders performed the Stormnexus Ritual.

description_citations.text: "Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The performers conjure a diorama of the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon and narrate the discovery of the Stormnexus Ritual; Narset recalls the desperate gamble.
timeline.quote: It'd been a gamble; they had no idea what the ritual would do.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones " by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: At the Crucible Narset recalls the battle against the dragonlords on Shiko, and shows Elspeth the floating hedrons.
timeline.quote: Ugin taught her how to shape them.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: A mysterious voice calls them to a temple as a dragonstorm gathers overhead; Narset sends her dragon away.
timeline.quote: Above, a storm began to gather, serrated clouds giving way to the suggestion of eyes, bared teeth.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan emerges at the Crucible, saying he is looking for hope in the dragonstorm and that all the Multiverse will become a realm of dragons.
timeline.quote: All of the Multiverse will become a realm of dragons.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Elspeth easily defeats Sarkhan, and Narset blasts him when he springs up to stab Elspeth in the back.
timeline.quote: The blast sent Sarkhan crashing to the ground ten feet away, panting and boneless and stunned.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Elspeth sheathes her sword and warns Sarkhan she will kill him if he attacks again.
timeline.quote: If you attack us again, I'll kill you.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Ugin falls on Tarkir after fighting Nicol Bolas, carving the chasm of the Crucible.
timeline.quote: Ugin’s impact shattered the tundra, carving a massive chasm in the Qal Sisma mountains

citation.text: "Crucible of the Spirit Dragon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan defies Yasova and uses a hedron fragment to encase Ugin in a restorative cocoon.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan defied Yasova’s attempt to stop him

citation.text: "Crucible of the Spirit Dragon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov performs a ritual that sunders the hedrons and frees Ugin in 4559 AR.
timeline.quote: performed a ritual that sundered the hedrons, freeing Ugin from his long slumber

citation.text: "Crucible of the Spirit Dragon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ugin and Sarkhan reunite and discuss how Bolas manipulated Sarkhan and how he changed Tarkir's history.

citation.text: "Crucible of the Spirit Dragon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Stormnexus Ritual unleashes a dragonstorm in the Crucible; the dragonlords fall to new spirit dragons.
timeline.quote: The dragonlords fell, freeing Tarkir’s clans

citation.text: "Crucible of the Spirit Dragon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon the ritual calls up a dragonstorm; Narset leaps onto a spirit and shapes it, and the dragon spirits are bound to the new clan leaders.
timeline.quote: In a flash of power, the dragon spirits and what would become the new clan leaders were bound.

citation.text: "Tarkir", section "The Stormnexus Ritual". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The dragonlords fight the new spirit dragons and are defeated, seemingly swallowed by the storm.
timeline.quote: In the end, the dragonlords were defeated and seemingly swallowed up by the massive storm.

citation.text: "Tarkir", section "The Stormnexus Ritual". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2025.

pages_say.description: The place where a voice told Narset and Elspeth to seek a temple in the dragonstorms.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Mar 2025.

pages_say.description: Long ravine in the Qal Sisma mountains of Tarkir, sacred to the Temur, formed where Ugin fell and was encased in a hedron cocoon.
